description: Value of 1 pip for a forex pair and position size, converted to a given account currency via a live FX rate: TrueFX for its 10 quoted majors (genuinely live tick data), frankfurter.app daily ECB reference rate as the fallback for every other currency (30 total). Use when user asks "what's 1 pip worth in my account currency?" and the account currency differs from the pair's own quote currency (if it matches, workflow.run_forex_pip_value alone is enough, no live fetch needed). Returns everything workflow.run_forex_pip_value does, plus accountCurrency, pipValueAccount, fxRate, fxSource (truefx/frankfurter/identity), available (false + error if no rate could be found for that currency).

pair.description: Currency pair in BASE/QUOTE format, e.g. "EUR/USD"

name: workflow.run_forex_pip_value_live
